website_url_note: mercavine.com DNS CNAMEs to the Railway service. Until the custom domain is attached in Railway, the app is live at https://mercavine-web-production.up.railway.app.
logotype_url_note: Square SVG with a background plate, served by the app at /logo.svg.
mcp_server_url_note: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <bot token>. Shoppers create a token at https://mercavine.com/account/bots.
brief_description: Mercavine lets a shopper's agent search home improvement, tools, and electronics accessories, then hand the human one approval link. The connector is free. Each seller is charged on their own Stripe account, and Mercavine takes a 3% application fee from that charge (not from the shopper). The bot never sees or completes payment.
fee_example: A $100.00 seller charge includes a $3.00 application fee. The shopper total does not increase.
tested_locally_note: Check the form's tested-locally box. npm test covers the mock checkout. Reviewers sign up at /signup, add an address, and connect a bot at /account/bots.
publisher_terms: Draft terms and privacy policy are served at /terms and /privacy. They list Mercavine as the contact (privacy@mercavine.com) and the 3% seller fee.

auth.optional_request_signatures: Ed25519 HTTP message signatures with a public key registered on the bot
